quickStartSteps: Pick a game mode under General: Normal for tracking, Casual for full assistance, Hardcore for timer only.
Adjust tasks and stages under Progression.
Press Save & apply. Most changes take effect immediately.
In game: /run start begins a run, /run reset starts over, /run help lists all commands.

progression.intro: Stages run in order of their keys (for example 1_..., 2_...). A stage is complete when all of its tasks are done. Changes to stages apply when no run is active.
progression.newStagePrompt: Key of the new stage (letters, digits, underscore). Stages run in alphabetical order, e.g. 6_END:
progression.invalidKey: Use letters, digits, and underscores only.
progression.emptyTasks: No tasks. The stage completes immediately.
progression.taskKeyHelp: Minecraft item name (IRON_INGOT) or STRUCTURE_<LOCATION>. OAK_LOG counts all wood, BREAD all cooked food.

rewards.intro: Rewards play when a task or a stage is completed. Use sound and particle entries; console commands can only be added in config.yml.
rewards.inactive: Rewards are turned off. The lists are kept and used when rewards are enabled.

blocks.p: Speedrun adds a run timer, staged tasks, location tracking, and optional navigation help to a normal Minecraft server. It works on Paper, Spigot, and CraftBukkit.

ol: Put the jar into the plugins folder and start the server once.
Join as an operator and run /run webconfig. Click the link to open this editor.
Choose a game mode, adjust the tasks, and press Save & apply.
/run start begins a run (or join first if “Start when the first player joins” is on).

blocks.p: The run ends automatically when the Ender Dragon dies. The final time is announced and compared with your personal best.
Timer, scoreboard with found locations, stages, and tasks. Locations are detected when players find them.

Everything in Normal plus a Navigation Compass with a destination menu, light beams over found locations, glowing gold blocks in the Nether, coordinates in the tab list, and an optional background search for structures.
Only the timer. All assistance and detection is turned off.
Stages are completed in the order of their keys, so name them 1_..., 2_..., 3_.... When every task of a stage is done, the next stage begins and rewards play.

ul: Item tasks use Minecraft item names such as IRON_INGOT or ENDER_PEARL.
OAK_LOG counts every kind of log and wood. BREAD counts every cooked food.
Structure tasks: STRUCTURE_VILLAGE, STRUCTURE_LAVA_POOL, STRUCTURE_NETHER_PORTAL, STRUCTURE_FORTRESS, STRUCTURE_BASTION, STRUCTURE_END_PORTAL.
“Scale by players” raises the amount when more players are online.

blocks.p: “Shown in” decides in which dimension a stage's tasks appear on the scoreboard.
All commands start with /run (alias /sr). Players need speedrun.player (everyone by default); administration needs speedrun.admin (operators by default).

ul: /run status, /run tasks, /run records, /run givecompass – for everyone
/run start, pause, stop, reset – control the run (also from the console)
/run new <location> [x y z] – set a location manually; /run remove <location> – hide it
/run locate pos1 / pos2 – estimate the stronghold from two Eye of Ender throws
/run skipstage – complete the current stage (the run will not count for records)
/run reload – reload config.yml and messages; /run webconfig – open this editor

blocks.p: Your edits stay in this browser tab until you save them. Save & apply writes config.yml and updates the running server in one step.

ul: Applies immediately: takes effect right away.
Restarts the related feature: the feature (for example waypoints) restarts with the new values.
Applies when no run is active: rules of the current run are not changed mid-run. The setting is saved; press Apply saved changes after /run reset or /run stop.
Needs /run reload or a restart: startup settings such as the editor port.

blocks.p: If the configuration was changed elsewhere in the meantime, the editor asks you to reload so nothing is overwritten by accident.

When a new plugin version starts, config.yml is upgraded automatically. Your values are kept, new settings get their defaults, and values that are no longer supported are reset. The previous file is saved to plugins/Speedrun/config-backups/ and every change is listed in migration-report.txt there.
Customized message files in plugins/Speedrun/lang are never overwritten; only new messages are added.

Heavy work runs outside the server thread: chunk contents are copied as snapshots and searched by background threads. On Paper, missing chunks are loaded asynchronously; on Spigot and CraftBukkit at most one chunk per tick is loaded, and only if you allow it.

ul: Background search Safe or Balanced is enough for most servers.
Keep the gold highlight radius moderate (24 is a good value).
Track every player step and trace diagnostics produce large files; enable them only when needed.

blocks.p: The editor listens on 127.0.0.1 by default and every request needs the private key from /run webconfig. The key changes on every restart and with /run webconfig restart.

ul: Do not share the link: whoever has it can change the settings.
To reach the editor from another computer, prefer an SSH tunnel over changing the network address.
Rewards that run console commands can only be added in config.yml, never from the editor (unless explicitly allowed there).
The link does not open: check that web-config.enabled is on and the port is free, then use /run webconfig restart.
A location is wrong: stand at the right spot and use /run new <location>, or give coordinates.
The compass HUD is missing on CraftBukkit: use Spigot or Paper for the full feature set.
Something behaves oddly: enable Trace diagnostics, reproduce it, and attach the newest file from plugins/Speedrun/traces to your report.
